a.xlink:title: Adds common input fields to the north panel.
Creates the color selection panel for QR code and background colors.
Opens a color chooser dialog and updates the button with the selected color.
Collects current input and visual settings into a WholeFields for QR code generation.
Initializes a color button with icon, text, and tooltip.
Updates and schedules a debounced QR code preview refresh.
Updates a button's icon and text to reflect a new color.
Converts a Color object to its hexadecimal RGB string representation.
Creates a square icon filled with the specified color and a visible border.
Disposes the current icon of a button to free memory.
Clears input fields corresponding to the active generation mode upon exceeding capacity limits.
Validates and returns the current QR code margin from the margin slider.
Validates and returns the current meet UID from the meet title field.
Validates and returns the current image-to-QR ratio from the ratio slider.
Validates and returns the QR code size from the corresponding text field.
